{{Top|leg}}
The '''Unforgettables''' started as a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] cell. Their first action was to wipe the memories of the entire droid complement of a new [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]].

==History==
Although they started as just a rebellious group of pranksters, when their leader was captured attempting another memory wipe and indefinitely imprisoned, they quickly accelerated their campaign against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. They vowed to wipe any droid important to the Imperial presence. They started wiping [[Service droid/Legends|servant]] and [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droids]]. They then moved to wiping droids that performed important functions like starport-control and other duties vital to civilians. This led them to be denounced by the Rebel Alliance and the Unforgettables were soon hunted by the Empire and Rebel Alliance alike.
